svg.title: THE CRASH WINDOW
svg.desc: Flow of a crashed side-effect step: the worker charges and dies before the checkpoint, recovery probes the vendor with a capsule, a landed answer skips the retry while not landed runs it with the same key, both rejoin at the checkpoint, and an unknown answer waits and asks again.
